svg.title: Sealed login — post-quantum encrypted password login
svg.desc: Use case: a player logs in. Phase 1 fetches a one-time key offer signed by the server's ML-DSA-65 identity; phase 2 sends the password sealed to that key. Any failure in phase 2 (unknown key, bad tag, relabelled action) is dropped silently — the client learns nothing.
